context.in_practice: There is only one route here, and all six implementations behaved the same way. No command changed any file.
context.stakes: When you run `config show <key>` without `--sources`, the output should be exactly what `config get <key>` prints. Otherwise scripts and people reading `show` would see a different value than `get` reports for the same key.
context.tradeoff: Route 1: `show` uses the same printing code as `get`, so the two always match. Whatever `get` prints (for example, `1000.0` for `1e3`) is also what `show` prints.

plan_why: Runs `show` without --sources on tricky scalars (a 1e3 float, a text include with no final newline, a keep-chomped block, a ~ null) and runs `get` on one of them, so you can check that show prints scalars byte-for-byte like get.
routes: Printed exactly as get prints it through the same function
